hook.name: PhoenixV4ReturnDeltaHook
hook.description: A return-delta hook for the Phoenix PXT/USDC pool that collects fees by adjusting swap deltas. Buys are charged a USDC skim; sells burn ~1.85% of PXT and skim USDC at a base rate, escalating to a penalty rate for large sells within a rolling window. Sell access is gated by a timestamp-based unlock and an anti-bot boolean cleared by the owner post-launch.
